{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Divine Fountain
| Image = Event-DivineFountain.png
}}
{{E|The Divine Fountain}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]]. This event can only appear if you have a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}} in your deck.

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Drink}} {{TS|positive||Remove all}} {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curses}} {{TS|positive||from your deck.}}

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You come across {{TS|blue|up|shimmering water}} flowing endlessly from a fountain on a nearby wall.
</div>

{{Frame|Drink}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As you drink the {{TS|blue|up|water,}} you feel a {{TS|purple||dark grasp}} loosen.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Unsure of the nature of this water, you continue on your way, parched.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* Removing all Curses may not be beneficial if you are relying on the {{BD|Strength}} from {{R|Du-Vu Doll}}.
* The Max HP gain from {{R|Darkstone Periapt}} is kept even when the Curses are removed.
